name: Ninetales
description: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.description: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Memento
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

moves.name: Healing Wish
moves.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.description: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
